column2: Build the vertical selector as the site's entry view - the FIRST thing a visitor sees, ahead of the hero. Founder-confirmed; specified in DESIGN.md §4 "Vertical selector - the site's entry view". Read design-refs/REFERENCES.md and OPEN design-refs/strips/Clary_Selector.png before writing anything: "Are you a..." centred on a clean light ground, one pill per vertical (Museums & Galleries / Gyms), hover colourises the pill, and on selection the tab DRIFTS TO THE TOP RIGHT while the chosen view FADES IN CLEANLY, the tab staying there as the switch control. You are judged on distance from that 10/10 reference, not on being better than best. Three attached decisions in §4: remember the choice locally so returning visitors are not re-gated; retire the existing in-hero switcher so there is one control rather than two; and NEVER gate content from a deep link or a crawler - every existing floor loads / and expects the page, and tests/gimmicks.spec.ts drives the hero-tab-museums and hero-tab-gyms testids, so those must keep working wherever the control now lives. Freeze all of it under prefers-reduced-motion.

Rebuild the scroll experience on top of branch cand-20260908-105409-1 - merge that branch first, do not start from scratch; the founder prefers its direction. Two defects to fix, both now enforced by tests/reveal.spec.ts. FIRST: content stays greyed out. 44 text elements never reached full opacity while sitting 80px clear of both viewport edges after a 700ms settle - headings at 0.14, body copy at 0.28 - so the page reads properly at only one exact scroll position. A reveal is a transition INTO a readable state, never a permanent scroll-linked dimmer. SECOND: grounds change with a hard visible edge. Per Claryo 10/10 (open design-refs/strips/Claryo_Scroll_Functionality_2.png and Claryo_Scroll_Functionality.png), scrolling far enough should leave the page simply having become white, or black, with NO distinct line across the page separating the two. Every scroll should surface something: content arriving in sequence, or the ground changing. Anti-reference, do not reproduce: design-refs/strips/Slingshot_Scroll.png (2/10) - merged sections, walls of prose, no interaction below the hero. Do NOT touch the ambient background: it is PARKED. Do not touch the hero demos (§3).
